name: Product demonstration
description: Show how the product works, step by step, ending on the result.

scenes.label: Hook
scenes.visualDirection: The product, clearly, in the first two seconds.

scenes.label: Step 1
scenes.visualDirection: First step of using the product, hands visible.
scenes.promptScaffold: Hands demonstrating the first step of using {appearance} on {setting}. Top-down or close framing. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Step 2
scenes.promptScaffold: Hands demonstrating the next step of using {appearance} on {setting}. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Result
scenes.promptScaffold: The finished result of using {appearance}, neatly presented on {setting}. {camera}. {lighting}. {toneMood}.

scenes.label: Call to action
scenes.visualDirection: Product with offer and call to action.
